bio.text: Adriano Espaillat represents New York's 13th Congressional District, covering parts of Harlem, Washington Heights, Inwood and the northwest Bronx, and was first sworn in on January 3, 2017.
His office says he is the first Dominican American to serve in the U.S. House and the first formerly undocumented immigrant elected to Congress.
He serves on the House Appropriations Committee and was elected chairman of the Congressional Hispanic Caucus for the 119th Congress.
